maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from restaurant dining at STK, Benihana, Kona Grill and RA Sushi; meals are consumed, not maintenance.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private diners and consumers paying for steak, sushi and teppanyaki meals at restaurants.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by opening restaurants and licensing, management and franchising; Benihana and Kona Grill were occasional large acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Diners can easily choose another restaurant; no switching cost, retraining or regulatory barrier for consumers.
